description: Find an existing appointment WITHOUT knowing its id — search by subject, participant, lead or period. This is the tool to use before update_calendar_event, update_meeting or delete_calendar_event, all of which need an id. Searches ALL of the user's calendars by default — their own and every agent's — because the point is that you do not know where the appointment is; each result names its `calendar`. Searches both calendar entries and booked meetings. Every result carries `update_with`, naming the tool that accepts THAT id: a meeting id is not accepted by update_calendar_event and vice versa. `query` matches the subject, description, notes, location and participant names, all words must match, case and accents are ignored. Results are nearest-first (future before past), and each carries `start_local` — the same instant as a wall clock in the event's timezone, so it can be compared with Google Calendar directly. Optional: query, lead_id, from/to (ISO), user_id, include_meetings (default true), limit.

agent_id.description: Narrow to one agent's calendar. Omit to search ALL of the user's calendars — their own and every agent's; that is the point of this tool.

lead_id.description: Only appointments linked to this lead

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

query.description: Subject, participant or any word from the entry

timezone.description: IANA zone that from/to are meant in, and the fallback for reading stored times. Defaults to the calendar owner's.

name: find_calendar_event
